name: Toast
summary: A brief, auto-dismissing confirmation of an action — rendered through antd's message API.
lead: Toast is antd's imperative `message` API — a transient confirmation that appears, then fades — and keeps antd's built-in motion, so it stays on real Ant: antd v6 (React) and ant-design-vue v4 (Vue), both themed once by the shared toastTheme. Two implementations, one DS V3 look. This is the composite half of the hybrid.

spec.label: Surface
spec.value: white elevated pill · radius 8 · ink #1A1A1A text

props.name: duration
props.desc: Seconds on screen; 0 keeps it until dismissed

whenToUse.when: confirming a quick action succeeded (saved, copied, sent) with nothing to act on
a richer message with a title + description, or one the user may need later
a persistent, inline message tied to a region of the page

opinion.note: One line, past tense, no title. Never put an action inside a toast that disappears — if the user must respond, use a Notification or a Modal.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — antd v6 message API, themed by the shared toastTheme (white pill · radius 8 · ink #1A1A1A text · top-centre). Matrix: type × { success, info, warning, error, loading } — each rendered via the message.useMessage() hook + contextHolder inside <ConfigProvider> (the DS forbids the static message.success(), which bypasses the theme). duration (3s default, 0 = sticky) is the second axis. Verified via Figma search_design_system against the DS V3 message set (Component/MD-Message text style — 'toast, alert, message').

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: Composite has no framework-free element, so its paste-and-run form is a CDN-React page — React + antd load from a CDN and mount on open, consuming the same shared toastTheme. No build step.

codeNote: React and Vue are two real vendor libraries at two Ant generations — they can't share a primitive. They converge via the same toastTheme; residual drift is caught by visual regression.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Composite shown as a CDN-React page; a sticky toast (duration 0) is opened on mount so the measure reads the real antd v6 message notice bound to toastTheme.
